name: Delivery to the Gnomes
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Now that I have what I need, give these parts to Fizzle Brassbolts.  He's been waiting a long time for them -- I'm sure he won't miss the little piece I removed from his order...

And I wouldn't bother mentioning it to him.  It was small and worthless.

Trust me.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Delicate Car Parts to Fizzle Brassbolts in Shimmering Flats.
narrative.offerRewardText: There they are! My hydro ratchets and repeater bolts! These will do just fine. Thank you!
narrative.requestItemsText: You have something for me? That's great! let's see it!

chain.subtitle: 12 quests from level 36 to 44, 19,370 XP in all.

quests.objectiveText: Bring Kravel's Parts to Kravel Koalbeard in the Shimmering Flats.
